canon.name: Trump OS
canon.frame: a full screen view of Trump OS, a made up gold plated presidential operating system, its interface filling the whole frame edge to edge, seen flat and straight on by a locked static camera, evenly lit
canon.still: The screen holds steady for the whole clip while the gold banner shimmers and the eagle mascot puffs out its chest
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} flashes bright gold and sparkles
canon.arrive: {thing} bursts open {place} with a bright cash register ring, already roaring with life
canon.leave: {thing} spins away in a swirl of gold glitter
canon.settle: In the last second everything comes to rest and the screen holds steady as a clean sharp picture of the gold desktop, every icon and button in its place
canon.ambient: Quiet casino lobby room tone, with a distant crowd murmuring far away
canon.selectSound: A soft gold plated tap with a tiny bright chime
canon.lettering: slender, widely spaced high contrast serif capitals, black on gold and gold on red
canon.style: glossy flat screen capture, gold, red, royal blue

filler: Every surface is flat and front facing, like a real desktop screenshot
The gold marble has thin, fine gold veins and a polished shine
Each icon casts a soft deep red velvet shadow
The gold plaques are smooth and bright with crisp edges
All lettering is one slender high contrast serif in capitals, widely spaced like a luxury hotel sign
The lighting is flat and even, like a casino lobby
The colors are rich gold, deep red velvet, white and royal blue
The icons are stacked in one narrow column, evenly spaced with clear gold marble between them
The taskbar has a thick polished gold shine with a bright top edge
Edges are crisp and the metal surfaces are smooth
The whole picture is sharp and steady
The screen fills the frame edge to edge with a steady exposure
Lettering is small, crisp and high contrast, with clear space around every word
The framing stays fixed on the whole screen from start to end
